Grappling Hook and Rope.name: Grappling Hook and Rope
Grappling Hook and Rope.description: Climbing DL 3 anywhere the hook sticks.

Quiver.name: Quiver
Quiver.description: Carries 20 arrows or bolts that cost nothing to draw. Can be slung on a belt.

Alcohol.name: Alcohol
Alcohol.description: 0.5L flask that can be thrown to coat 1 space in flammable alcohol.

Oil Flask.name: Oil Flask
Oil Flask.description: 0.5L flask that can be thrown to coat 1 space in flammable oil. Cannot be extinguished with water. Can be used to make a torch.

Pitch Pot.name: Pitch Pot
Pitch Pot.description: Pot of pitch with a fuse that can be thrown and burns for 12 burning damage per round and sticks to 1 space or target and produces smoke (black smoke, 2m radius, 1 min fill). This does not extinguish with water and requires 8 AP to be muffled.

Smoke Bundle.name: Smoke Bundle
Smoke Bundle.description: Improvised, consumed by use. Damp greenery, dung, or straw rolled in cloth. Produces smoke (white smoke, 2m radius, 5 min fill).

Torch.name: Torch
Torch.description: Improvised, discarded after use. Gives 5m light radius when lit, requires an oil flask to burn for 4 hours. Can be used to block attack at RES 10. Lighting it is a DL -2 exploration test.

Smoke Grenade.name: Smoke Grenade
Smoke Grenade.description: Can be thrown or attached to a projectile and produces 3m radius of white smoke.

Anticoagulant Poison.name: Anticoagulant Poison
Anticoagulant Poison.description: Adds +1 bleed to any attack. Vial with 10 applications.

Paralytic Poison.name: Paralytic Poison
Paralytic Poison.description: DL 5 health to avoid becoming immobile within 20 turns on a graze or in 10 turns on a miss. Paralysis lasts for 1 hour/ 4 hours respectively.

Necrotic Poison.name: Necrotic Poison
Necrotic Poison.description: Character must make a DL 8 Health test in the next exploration turn. On a miss, they receive 5 IL. On a graze, 2. The effect does not wear off until a hit is scored.

Soporific Poison.name: Soporific Poison
Soporific Poison.description: Inhalation or ingested. Target must make a DL 5 Health test. On a graze or miss, after 2 minutes, the target falls Unconscious for 1 hour. The target will awake if damaged, but will fall asleep again once danger ends.

Caltrops.name: Caltrops
Caltrops.description: A scattered space. Balance DL 3 to avoid taking 10 piercing damage to the leg on a graze or 15 on a miss. One purchase covers one space.

Tripwire.name: Tripwire
Tripwire.description: An undetected tripwire forces a balance check DL 3 to avoid falling prone. Detection DL 5.

Rolling Log.name: Rolling Log
Rolling Log.description: 1 ton of wood released downhill along a path. Treat as a huge projectile. Deals 30 blunt damage and pushes with a DL of 30.

Alchemical Torch.name: Alchemical Torch
Alchemical Torch.description: Allows the use of light spells.

Superior Alchemical Torch.name: Superior Alchemical Torch
Superior Alchemical Torch.description: An alchemical torch that amplifies magic once.

Electrite.name: Electrite
Electrite.description: A magically activated electrical battery stone. Deals 10 base electric damage. 20 charges.

Superior Electrite.name: Superior Electrite
Superior Electrite.description: Every spell is amplified once automatically. 20 charges.

Magnetite.name: Magnetite
Magnetite.description: Can be placed into gear to give magnetic properties.

Fire Stone.name: Fire Stone
Fire Stone.description: Allows the production of fire from it, dealing 10 base burn damage. 20 charges.

Flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
Flamethrower.description: A stick mounted with a fire stone to apply pressure to the flames, deals 15 base burn damage.

Condenser.name: Condenser
Condenser.description: Allows the extraction of water from the air.

Simple Healing.name: Simple Healing
Simple Healing.description: Heals 5 extra IL over 1 short rest.

Medium Healing.name: Medium Healing
Medium Healing.description: Heals 10 extra IL over 1 short rest.

Good Healing.name: Good Healing
Good Healing.description: Heals 15 extra IL over 1 short rest.

Darkseeing.name: Darkseeing
Darkseeing.description: Allows seeing in the dark for 1 ET.

Anti-septic.name: Anti-septic
Anti-septic.description: Reduces infection exposure by 3 when applied with a bandage. 10 charges.

Antibiotic Poultice.name: Antibiotic Poultice
Antibiotic Poultice.description: Reduces infection exposure by 2 when consumed. 5 charges.

Cocaine.name: Cocaine
Cocaine.description: Removes the effects of exhaustion for 1 ET, but doubles Wear. Does not prevent unconsciousness. 5 charges.

Morphine.name: Morphine
Morphine.description: Becomes intoxicated, but gets no injury penalty to morale tests. 5 charges.

Ayahuasca.name: Ayahuasca
Ayahuasca.description: Causes confusion, but increases shamanism by +5. 5 charges.

Antidote.name: Antidote
Antidote.description: Removes effect of poison. Price and availability depend on poison. 5 charges.

Oilcloth.name: Oilcloth
Oilcloth.description: A personal tent that counts as shelter against rain.

Small Tent.name: Small Tent
Small Tent.description: Allows you to set up camp without skill. Has space for 2 people and counts as shelter against rain and wind. Also reduces any exposure by 1.

Large Tent.name: Large Tent
Large Tent.description: Allows you to set up camp without skill. Has space for 4 people and counts as shelter against rain and wind. Also reduces any exposure by 1.

Oil Lamp.name: Oil Lamp
Oil Lamp.description: Gives 5m light radius when lit, requires an oil flask to burn for 8 hours.

Flint.name: Flint
Flint.description: Allows lighting a campfire within minutes, no test required.

Firewood.name: Firewood
Firewood.description: Dry wood ready to burn for 4 hours.

Rope.name: Rope
Rope.description: 10 meters. Useful item. Sold per meter.

Pot.name: Pot
Pot.description: Used to boil water and cook up to 10 portions, improving the preparation test by 2.

Chalk.name: Chalk
Chalk.description: Makes being followed trivial in the marked path. It is spent in one ET and lasts until it rains.

Insect Repellant.name: Insect Repellant
Insect Repellant.description: Reduces exposure to insects by 2. Lasts for 1 sleep.

Fur Cloak.name: Fur Cloak
Fur Cloak.description: Improves resistance to cold exposure by +2.

Camouflage.name: Camouflage
Camouflage.description: Where X is the terrain. Gives +3 to Stealth vs vision outside combat. -3 penalty in combat in plain sight.

Snow Shoes.name: Snow Shoes
Snow Shoes.description: Cancels penalty for walking in the snow.

Armor Repair Kit.name: Armor Repair Kit
Armor Repair Kit.description: Allows repairing armor in the field.
